description: This Java class 'DittoBsonJson' provides specialized conversion between BSON and JSON formats, handling special character replacements for '$' and '.' in JSON keys, used within the MongoDB persistence context of the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: DittoBsonJson
classes.description: A utility class for converting between BSON and JSON with special handling for characters in keys.

methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of DittoBsonJson.

methods.description: Serializes BsonValue (either BsonDocument or BsonArray) to JSON, applying character replacements.
